people.name: Shri Ambrish Tripathi
people.evidence_quote: Shri Ambrish Tripathi (DIN: 11888363), General Manager - Kotdwar Unit of BEL as Director (HR) on the Board of Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and in this regard, the Board of Directors through Circular Resolution approved the appointment of Shri Ambrish Tripathi, Director (HR) as Additional Director w.e.f 13th August, 2026.
people.tenure_quote: Till the date of his superannuation i.e 31.12.2028, or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
people.bio_quote: Shri Ambrish Tripathi took charge as Director (Human Resources) of Navratna Defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) today. He was working as General Manager (Kotdwar) / BEL since 01 Jan 2024 prior to his elevation.

people.name: Shri Anoop Kumar Rai
people.evidence_quote: Shri Anoop Kumar Rai (DIN: 11888162), ED, CRL-Ghaziabad of BEL as Director (Marketing) on the Board of Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and in this regard, the Board of Directors through Circular Resolution approved the appointment of Shri Anoop Kumar Rai (DIN: 11888162), Director (Marketing) as Additional Director w.e.f 13th August, 2026.
people.tenure_quote: Till the date of his superannuation i.e 30.09.2028, or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
people.bio_quote: Shri Anoop Kumar Rai took charge as Director (Marketing) of Navratna Defence PSU Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) today. He was working as Executive Director (CRL-Ghaziabad) since 01 Aug 2025 prior to his elevation.
